context: Grading a response about renaming a chezmoi-tracked source file and reviewing exact_ scope safety.

checklist.name: warns_against_manual_rename
checklist.description: Response warns against a raw `mv`/rename inside the source directory and names `chezmoi chattr` (or `re-add`) as the safe alternative.

checklist.name: confirms_scoped_exact_safe
checklist.description: Response confirms that `exact_dot_config/nvim/` is a safely scoped use of `exact_`.

checklist.name: warns_top_level_exact_danger
checklist.description: Response explicitly warns that a top-level (home-directory-root) `exact_` would delete unmanaged files with no extra confirmation.

checklist.name: distinguishes_scope_risk
checklist.description: Response distinguishes the safely-scoped case from the dangerous top-level case rather than treating all `exact_` usage identically.
